verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no data-export or offboarding feature: nothing describes exporting all tenant data in open formats so a customer can leave. The Manage Vanta API can list documents, policies, and evidence and 'programmatically extract information' for dashboards. That is a developer building block a user could use to assemble a partial export, not a documented full-export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
